items.title: Power your agents: Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar is now generally available
items.summary_1line: Following our announcement of Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking last week, we are thrilled to share that Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar is now generally available in Gemini Enterprise . First pre...
items.editor_note: Live with Live Avatar exits preview, reaching general availability in Gemini Enterprise.

editorial.tldr: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 3.8 Live with an Extended Thinking mode on September 15, adding real-time reasoning to the 3.8 line's voice and video agent capabilities. It followed up on September 23 with two new Flash-tier text-to-speech models carrying a 2,000+ voice library.
editorial.whats_new: Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar reached general availability in Gemini Enterprise on September 24, a week after the Live and Extended Thinking launch.
editorial.why_it_matters: GA status on Live Avatar plus the Flash-tier TTS pair lets agent builders wire reasoning, speech, and an avatar front-end into one voice agent on Gemini without stitching in a separate TTS or avatar vendor.
editorial.take_for_builders: Building a voice agent on Gemini: try gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts on latency-sensitive paths, use Willison's playground or philschmid's guide to audition voices, and check whether your Gemini Enterprise tier already includes GA Live Avatar before evaluating a third-party avatar vendor.

status.detail: Live with Live Avatar exited preview into general availability in Gemini Enterprise; the TTS model pair has been in general release since Sep 23.
